description: Enables the mob to admire items that have been configured as admirable.

admire_item_sound.description: The sound event to play when admiring the item

on_admire_item_start.description: Event to run when the mob starts admiring an item.

on_admire_item_stop.description: Event to run when the mob stops admiring an item.

priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.

sound_interval.description: The range of time in seconds to randomly wait before playing the sound again. Can be a number, an array [min, max], or an object with range_min and range_max.
